title: Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation Before Official Release
description:
**Task**: Before transitioning this product from public preview to official release, perform comprehensive vulnerability scanning and remediation of all CRITICAL and HIGH level vulnerabilities found.

- Run the latest vulnerability scans against all relevant images and dependencies
- Prioritize remediation of all CRITICAL and HIGH findings 
- Document all remediation steps and validate effectiveness
- Confirm no CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities remain (or document and justify any exceptions)
- Indicate readiness for production release after remediation

This is a release-blocking requirement to ensure the security posture of the software.

title: Grant CI permissions for image attestation/signing
description:
Part of posit-dev/images-shared#453. Depends on the signing-method spike in that repo.

Grant whatever job permissions the chosen signing method requires (e.g. `id-token: write` + `attestations: write` for GitHub Artifact Attestations) to workflows that call the shared build workflow with `push: true`:

- production.yml
- development.yml

Also document how to verify image attestations in this repo's README once the method is finalized.

title: Add RHEL 10 (UBI) support for package-manager
description:
Phase 1 of the RHEL 10 (UBI) initiative (posit-dev/images-shared#575).

PR #103 already implements Standard and Minimal builds on
`registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/ubi` (amd64 + arm64) against
package-manager 2026.05.0. Minimal passes dgoss (19/19); Standard fails
on R install because 2026.05.0 pins R 4.6.0, which has a hard
`Requires: flexiblas-devel` unavailable in UBI's redistributable CRB
subset.

That's fixed upstream — rstudio/r-builds#329 (merged) makes
`flexiblas-devel` a weak dependency, verified against R 4.6.1 on UBI
9/10. package-manager's current `latest` (2026.06.0) already pins R
4.6.1.

## Approach

- Retarget PR #103 (or open a fresh one) against 2026.06.0 instead of
  2026.05.0
- Fix the RHEL 10 gap in `posit_product/main.py`'s distro-tag resolver
  (`ProductEnum.PACKAGE_MANAGER` branch handles versions 7/8/9 but falls
  through to `"multi"` for 10)
- Re-run dgoss for both variants against the retargeted version

## Notes

This is the first production use of the `dnf.j2` macro (unit-tested,
never wired into a real Containerfile until this PR).
